title: Whether the guns duelled on 27 March
reading: Chinese field-gun fire on Liujiahu at 17:30 and 19:15; no duel
basis: The Japanese report on 27 March records Chinese shells on Liujiahu but no counter-battery fire, which is first ordered for the 28th; the Chinese account gives no hour.
